description: A classic, refreshing Turkish dip made with thick strained yogurt, crumbled white cheese, garlic, and fresh dill.

ingredients.name: Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage Total 5%) or labneh

ingredients.name: Turkish White Cheese (Beyaz Peynir) or Feta
ingredients.substitute: Greek feta in brine or mild French sheep's milk feta

steps.instruction: Mash the feta cheese with a fork in a mixing bowl until broken down into small crumbles. Mix thoroughly with the strained yogurt, crushed garlic, and finely chopped dill.
Drizzle in the extra virgin olive oil and season with salt, stirring vigorously until smooth, thick, and creamy.
Transfer to a serving bowl and chill in the refrigerator for at least 10 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to marry.

description: Velvety smooth chickpea dip enriched with tahini and lemon juice, crowned with warm foaming butter and cumin.

ingredients.name: Ice Cold Water
ingredients.substitute: Cold mineral water or ice cubes

ingredients.name: Unsalted Butter
ingredients.substitute: Extra virgin olive oil for a vegan option

steps.instruction: Combine the drained chickpeas, tahini, freshly squeezed lemon juice, crushed garlic, ground cumin, and salt in the bowl of a food processor. Process until coarsely ground.
With the motor running, drizzle in ice cold water a tablespoon at a time, processing for several minutes until the hummus turns ultra-smooth, light, and airy.
Melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat until gently sizzling and lightly foaming. Swirl hummus onto a shallow dish, drizzle the hot butter over top, and serve warm.

description: Tender fried cubes of eggplant and green peppers enveloped in a rich, garlicky tomato reduction.

ingredients.name: Green Bell Peppers (or Turkish sivri biber, chopped)
ingredients.substitute: Cubanelle peppers or Italian frying peppers

ingredients.name: Ripe Roma Tomatoes (grated or finely chopped)
ingredients.substitute: 1 cup canned crushed San Marzano tomatoes

steps.instruction: Peel the eggplant in alternating zebra stripes and cut into 3/4-inch bite-sized cubes. Sprinkle with salt and let rest for 10 minutes to draw out excess moisture, then thoroughly pat dry with paper towels.
Fry the eggplant cubes and chopped peppers in olive oil in batches over medium-high heat until tender and golden brown, then transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate.
In a saucepan, heat 1 tbsp olive oil and sauté the sliced garlic for 30 seconds. Stir in tomato paste and chopped tomatoes, simmering gently until thickened into a rich sauce.
Gently fold the fried vegetables into the warm tomato sauce. Allow to cool completely to room temperature or chill before serving.

description: Finely minced fresh tomatoes, peppers, and parsley tossed with tangy pomegranate molasses and fiery Turkish red pepper flakes.

ingredients.name: Green Pepper or Mild Jalapeño (finely minced)
ingredients.substitute: Turkish sivri green pepper or serrano

ingredients.name: Turkish Tomato Paste (Domates Salçası)
ingredients.substitute: Standard tomato paste mixed with 1/2 tsp hot pepper paste

ingredients.name: Pomegranate Molasses (Nar Ekşisi)
ingredients.substitute: 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice plus 1/2 tsp balsamic glaze

ingredients.name: Aleppo Pepper Flakes (Pul Biber)
ingredients.substitute: Crushed red pepper flakes or sweet Hungarian paprika

steps.instruction: Finely hand-mince the tomatoes, red bell pepper, and green pepper with a sharp chef's knife or Turkish zırh. Transfer to a fine-mesh strainer and press lightly to discard excess standing liquid.
In a mixing bowl, combine the drained vegetables with chopped parsley, tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, olive oil, Aleppo pepper flakes, and salt. Stir vigorously to incorporate.
Let stand at room temperature for 5 minutes for the seasonings and tart pomegranate juices to meld together, then transfer to a shallow meze platter and serve.

description: Silky Aegean spread of slow-cooked split fava beans scented with dill, olive oil, and sweet yellow onion.

ingredients.name: Dried Split Fava Beans (Kuru İç Bakla)

steps.instruction: Rinse the split fava beans under cold water. In a medium pot, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-low heat and gently sauté the chopped onion until translucent and soft.

Add the rinsed fava beans, sugar, salt, and enough warm water to cover by 1 inch (about 2.5 cups). Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low heat until the beans are completely tender and falling apart.

Purée with an immersion blender until velvety smooth, incorporating the lemon juice and remaining olive oil. Pour into a shallow rimmed dish, cool until set, and garnish with fresh dill and red onion.

titleEn: Spicy Strained Yogurt with Fried Dried Chilies (Atom)
description: Cool, creamy strained garlic yogurt topped with sizzling hot butter infused with fiery whole dried red chilies.

ingredients.name: Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage 5%) or labneh

ingredients.name: Dried Hot Red Chilies (or Turkish Arnavut Biberi)
ingredients.substitute: Whole dried Arbol chilies or crushed red pepper flakes

steps.instruction: Whisk the strained yogurt with finely crushed garlic and salt in a bowl until smooth and fluffy, then spread evenly across a shallow serving platter creating decorative ridges.
Melt the butter in a small skillet over medium heat until gently foaming. Add the dried red chilies and sizzle briefly for 30 to 45 seconds until aromatic and the butter turns crimson.
Immediately pour the hot bubbling chili butter over the cool yogurt base and serve warm with toasted crusty bread.

titleEn: Smoky Roasted Eggplant Salad (Köz Patlıcan Salatası)
description: Fire-roasted eggplant flesh coarsely chopped and dressed simply with crushed garlic, fresh lemon juice, and fruity olive oil.

steps.instruction: Prick the eggplants in several spots with a fork. Roast over an open gas flame or under an oven broiler at 450°F (230°C), turning frequently until skins are deeply charred and interior is completely soft.
Place the roasted eggplants in a covered bowl to steam for 10 minutes. Peel away the charred skins, drain excess liquid, and coarsely chop the tender flesh with a chef's knife.
In a bowl, toss the warm chopped eggplant with grated garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, chopped parsley, and salt until evenly combined. Serve at room temperature or chilled.

titleEn: Roasted Red Pepper and Walnut Dip (Muhammara)
description: Rich Levantine-Turkish spread made with roasted sweet red peppers, crunchy toasted walnuts, breadcrumbs, and tart pomegranate molasses.

ingredients.name: Jarred Roasted Red Peppers (rinsed and drained)
ingredients.substitute: Fresh fire-roasted red bell peppers (Kapia biber)

ingredients.name: Plain Breadcrumbs (Galeta Unu)
ingredients.substitute: Panko breadcrumbs or toasted stale country bread

ingredients.name: Pomegranate Molasses (Nar Ekşisi)
ingredients.substitute: 1 tbsp lemon juice plus 1 tsp honey or balsamic glaze

steps.instruction: Pulse the walnuts in a food processor until coarsely ground, leaving some small texture intact.
Add the drained roasted peppers, breadcrumbs, pomegranate molasses, olive oil, ground cumin, Aleppo pepper, and salt. Pulse continuously until a thick, textured spread forms.
Taste and balance with additional pomegranate molasses or salt if desired. Spoon into a shallow bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and garnish with walnut halves.

description: Sweet coarsely grated carrots gently caramelized in olive oil and folded into thick garlic strained yogurt.

ingredients.name: Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage Total 5%)

steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add grated carrots and sauté, stirring frequently, until tender and caramelized, about 7 to 8 minutes.
Transfer sautéed carrots to a plate and let cool completely. In a mixing bowl, combine strained yogurt, grated garlic, and salt, then fold in the cooled carrots.
Transfer to a presentation dish, top with toasted chopped walnuts, and chill for 15 minutes before serving.

titleEn: Circassian Chicken with Walnut Sauce (Çerkez Tavuğu)
description: Tender poached shredded chicken folded into a velvety, aromatic walnut, bread, and garlic paste finished with spiced paprika oil.

ingredients.name: Cooked Chicken Breast (tender shredded)
ingredients.substitute: Poached chicken thighs or rotisserie chicken breast

ingredients.name: Stale White Country Bread (crust removed)
ingredients.substitute: Sandwich bread slice or Turkish pide crumb

steps.instruction: Poach chicken breast in salted simmering water until tender, cool, and shred finely into delicate strands along the grain.
Soak bread in warm chicken broth, then blend in a food processor with walnuts, garlic, and salt until a rich, thick walnut paste forms.
Fold the walnut sauce into the shredded chicken. Warm olive oil with paprika in a small pan, drizzle the vibrant red oil over the chicken, and serve cold.

titleEn: Roasted Beet and Garlic Yogurt Dip (Pancar Mezesi)
description: Vibrant magenta meze combining tender roasted beets, strained garlic yogurt, fresh lemon juice, and olive oil.

ingredients.name: Red Beets (scrubbed and roasted or boiled)
Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage Total 5%)

steps.instruction: Roast beets wrapped in foil at 400°F (200°C) or boil until fork-tender. Allow to cool completely, then slip off skins under cold running water.
Coarsely grate the peeled beets and gently press with a paper towel to remove excessive free-running moisture.
In a mixing bowl, blend strained yogurt, grated garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt, then gently fold in the beets until beautifully magenta and creamy.

titleEn: Samphire with Garlic Lemon Dressing (Deniz Börülcesi)
description: Crisp Aegean sea beans blanched tender and dressed with zesty crushed garlic, fresh lemon, and cold-pressed olive oil.

ingredients.name: Fresh Samphire or Sea Beans (Deniz Börülcesi)
ingredients.substitute: Tender young asparagus tips or blanched haricots verts

steps.instruction: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil without adding salt. Blanch the samphire for 6 to 8 minutes until vibrant green and tender.
Drain immediately and plunge into an ice-water bath. Holding the tough woody root base of each stem, strip off the tender fleshy outer green portions.
Arrange the tender samphire on a platter. Whisk crushed garlic, fresh lemon juice, and olive oil together, pour over top, and serve at room temperature.

description: Hearty white bean salad tossed with thinly sliced red onions, fresh parsley, sumac, and a bright lemon vinaigrette.

ingredients.name: Cooked White Cannellini Beans (drained and rinsed)
ingredients.substitute: 1.5 cups home-cooked tender Great Northern beans

ingredients.name: Ground Sumac
ingredients.substitute: Fresh lemon zest with pinch of paprika

steps.instruction: Rinse and drain canned white beans thoroughly. Slice the red onion into thin half-moons and massage gently with a pinch of sumac to soften sharpness.
In a small bowl, whisk together the freshly squeezed lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, remaining sumac, and salt.
Combine the beans, onion slices, and chopped parsley in a salad bowl. Pour the vinaigrette over and toss gently until well coated. Garnish with hard-boiled egg slices if desired.

description: Crisp, succulent purslane leaves folded into creamy strained garlic yogurt and drizzled with golden olive oil.

ingredients.name: Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage Total 5%)

steps.instruction: Thoroughly rinse the fresh purslane leaves in cold water, spin dry completely, and pluck tender leaves and stems, discarding coarse woody stalks.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the strained yogurt, crushed garlic, extra virgin olive oil, and sea salt until smooth and creamy.
Add the dry purslane leaves into the yogurt sauce and fold gently with a spatula until evenly coated. Chill briefly before serving.

titleEn: Walnut and Feta Yogurt Dip (Girit Ezmesi)
description: Cretan-style Turkish cheese spread of crumbled feta, crunchy walnuts, garlic, fresh dill, and olive oil whipped with yogurt.

ingredients.name: Thick Strained Yogurt (Süzme Yoğurt)
ingredients.substitute: Plain whole-milk Greek yogurt (e.g., Fage Total 5%) or labneh

ingredients.name: Turkish White Cheese (Beyaz Peynir) or Greek Feta

steps.instruction: Mash the white feta cheese finely with a fork. In a bowl, combine strained yogurt, mashed cheese, crushed garlic, and finely chopped dill.
Fold in the finely chopped walnuts and extra virgin olive oil, seasoning with salt to taste and stirring until evenly incorporated.
Spoon into a serving dish, drizzle with additional olive oil, and chill for 10 minutes in the refrigerator before presenting.
